name: Piotr Müller - Après le § 63 - Am 13
title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: 63b. Stresses that current public procurement rules and the lack of strong and effective social conditions have created a downward pressure on labour costs and collective bargaining, and subsequently on working conditions and workers’ wages under public contracts; calls for the introduction of mandatory social and sustainability criteria, for example related to collective bargaining, in order to ensure a level playing field and to promote fair competition and fair working conditions;
